personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (with custom Deep Navy Fintech Palette)
personality_one_liner: A precision-crafted professional compliance and tax portal blending banking-grade trust, frictionless client workflows, and cinematic glassmorphism.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room, compact modular cards, and fixed bottom CTA with safe area clearance.

do's: Use frosted glass header and tab bar over scrolling content
Apply glass cards on featured analytics and active compliance items
dont's: Never blur form inputs or text content
Never stack more than 2 blur surfaces

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Animated brand intro followed by 4 value proposition slides with custom financial artwork.
screens.layout: Full bleed editorial carousel with dot indicators and sticky primary CTA.

screens.name: Auth & OTP
screens.purpose: Secure email and password login with instant 6-digit OTP verification.

states.error: Inline validation banner for invalid credentials

screens.layout: Centered form container with secure masked inputs and biometric prompt.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Client command center featuring Action Center status cards, multi-business switcher, and quick metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton shimmer cards for action center and metrics
states.empty: Friendly compliance checklist with start service CTA

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top sticky header, business switcher dropdown, horizontal action cards, and recent compliance timeline.

screens.name: Services Marketplace
screens.purpose: Catalog of tax, GST, accounting, audit, and registration services with transparent pricing.
screens.layout: Categorized pill filter row followed by 2-column service cards with instant request action.

screens.name: Documents & Vault
screens.purpose: Secure document repository where viewing and downloading is locked until payment is verified.

states.empty: No documents uploaded yet + Upload CTA

screens.layout: Tabbed filter (All, Tax, GST, Legal) with locked badge indicators and upload drawer.

screens.name: Payments & UPI Flow
screens.purpose: Invoices and fee clearance through UPI reference number submission and verification.
screens.layout: Invoice list cards with pay modal, QR code display, and UPI reference input field.

screens.name: Profile & Admin Web Dashboard
screens.purpose: Client profile, language toggle (English/Hindi), and integrated desktop-optimized /admin route.
screens.layout: Split-view admin analytics, client management table, and settings controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows the deep navy / dark blue professional palette with crisp white text and subtle blue gradients. Implement both the mobile client portal and the desktop admin dashboard at the /admin route. Enforce payment verification lock on document downloads. Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area insets are respected everywhere.
